images.title: Make 99, then add 1
images.purpose: Show Piku's method: make 9 in every place to reach 99, then add 1 to reach 100.
images.composition: The sum 46 + 53 = 99 with a +1 arrow to 46 + 54 = 100.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two sums joined by a plus 1 arrow. LEFT BOX: a rounded rectangle x 120 to 660, y 300 to 440, outlined teal #0072B2 4 px, with the text 46 + 53 = 99 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (72 px) centred. RIGHT BOX: a rounded rectangle x 796 to 1336, y 300 to 440, outlined green #009E73 4 px, with the text 46 + 54 = 100 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (72 px) centred. A curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 (6 px) from the top of the number 53 (x 540, y 300) over to the top of the number 54 (x 1195, y 300), peaking at y 200, with the label +1 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (72 px) in reddish purple centred at x 868, y 165. Under the left box, centred at x 390, y 510, the caption 4 and 5 make 9, 6 and 3 make 9 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (40 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Make 9 in every place, then add 1 to the blank: 46 + 54 = 100.
images.description: The sums 46 + 53 = 99 and 46 + 54 = 100 joined by a +1 arrow, with the nine partners 4 and 5, 6 and 3.
images.context: Concept image for Quick Sums and Differences with Round Numbers, Section A, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Point at each pair of digits that make 9, then at the extra 1. The slip to watch: stopping at 99.

images.title: Take away 10, give 1 back
images.purpose: Show that taking away 9 is taking away 10 and giving 1 back.
images.composition: A number line from 52 with a hop back of 10 to 42 and a hop forward of 1 to 43.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A number line with a hop back and a hop forward. The line is a dark #2B2B2B horizontal line (6 px) from x 100 to x 1356 at y 450, with three tick marks (4 px, 40 px tall, y 430 to 470): at x 320 labelled 42, at x 420 labelled 43 and at x 1100 labelled 52, each label in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (56 px) centred under its tick at y 520. A long hop back: a curved arrow in teal #0072B2 (6 px) above the line from x 1100 to x 320, peaking at y 250, with the label −10 in teal bold (72 px) centred at x 710, y 215. A short hop forward: a curved arrow in amber #E69F00 (6 px) below the line from x 320 to x 420, dipping to y 590, with the label +1 in amber bold (64 px) centred at x 370, y 650. At the top left, x 120, y 90, the caption 10 is 1 more than 9 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). At the bottom, centred at x 728, y 760, the line 52 − 9 = 43 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Take away the round number, then give 1 back: 52 − 10 + 1 = 43.
images.description: A number line with ticks 42, 43 and 52, a hop of −10 and a hop of +1.
images.context: Concept image for Quick Sums and Differences with Round Numbers, Section B, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Say why 1 is given back: 10 is 1 more than 9. The slip to watch: stopping at 42.

image_decisions.why: One video, two sections, one picture each: the +1 arrow shows that 99 is one short of 100 in Section A, and the two hops show taking away 10 and giving 1 back in Section B.
